_what: The transition bank. DEFINITIONS, not clips.
_why:
He asked for a transition bank so 'the video editor can analyse which one is suitable and watch the transition'. It cannot watch - it is code. And a folder of transition footage would not have caught the failure that made this file necessary.

The 240ms whip in DESAFARM_CINEMATIC_v2 did not fail because it was the wrong whoosh. It failed because it SHORTENED shot 8 by 197ms instead of OVERLAPPING it. Internal spacing between every other shot stayed perfect, so no per-shot check could see it - the back 60% of the film simply sat ~170ms early against the music. That is a property of the transition's DEFINITION (does it consume time or overlap it), and nothing else in the pipeline stated it.
_the_field_that_matters: timing. 'overlap' means the transition borrows frames from BOTH neighbours and the shot keeps its full length - the engine must RESERVE duration_ms of extra source. 'consume' means the transition eats duration_ms out of the outgoing shot and the timeline shortens. Get this wrong and every cut after it drifts, silently, forever.
_how_the_engine_uses_this: engine.py reads BLEND_KIND per index in BLEND_AFTER. For timing='overlap' it adds duration_ms to that shot's render length (already patched 2026-08-07). For timing='consume' it does not. planqc check 34 refuses a plan whose declared transition contradicts what the footage or the shot lengths can support.
_sfx_pairing: pairs_with_sfx is a literal query into assets/bank/bank_index.json via bank.py. It is not a filename, because a filename rots and a query does not. 126 files currently satisfy cut_safe=True.

transitions.why: The default. Costs nothing, drifts nothing, and is correct far more often than the alternatives. Every other entry in this file has to earn its place against this one.
transitions.when_scene: the default everywhere; energy, rhythm, honesty. Every other kind must beat it.

transitions.why: THE ONE THAT BROKE DESAFARM. Declared 240ms and delivered -197ms on shot 8 because the engine shortened instead of overlapping. timing='overlap' is the whole point of this entry. It also needs real motion on BOTH sides - a whip out of a static frame reads as a glitch, and the laplacian collapsed 463 -> 9 at the boundary, which verify flagged as a smear.
transitions.when_scene: speed/motion carries across the cut - driving, launch, chase. Needs real motion BOTH sides.

transitions.why: Works from a static frame, which whip does not - that is its only reason to exist. Capped at 2 because a third flash stops reading as emphasis and starts reading as a broken file. Interacts with check 5: a flash IS a luma spike, so it must be excluded from the exposure swing count or it fails a gate for doing its job.
transitions.when_scene: time jump, rewind, memory, camera-flash moment - works from static frames.

transitions.why: The only 'consume' transition with real duration, so it is the only one that legitimately shortens the timeline - the plan's TARGET_S must already account for it. Reads as a scene break, so at most one, and never inside the hook.
transitions.when_scene: geography or chapter change - state line, day boundary, arrival. A breath, not a blink.

transitions.why: The only entry with a similarity WINDOW rather than a ceiling. Below 0.72 the shapes do not rhyme and it reads as a normal cut; above 0.88 verify 13 correctly calls it a duplicate. This is the one transition that gets HARDER as it gets better, and it is why the duplicate check needed two axes - a match cut and a true duplicate look identical on composition alone.
transitions.when_scene: visual rhyme - wheel to sun, tunnel to tunnel. The most premium cut in the bank.
direction of travel continues across the cut - the road itself pushes the frame out.
transitions.why: POLISH-LAYER ONLY (his ruling 2026-08-12): an alpha mask swipe over the finished cut - the overlay never touches the timeline, so timing='overlap' here means the mask spans the boundary, not that the engine reserves frames. Zero drift by construction.

transitions.when_scene: golden-hour, nostalgia, emotional peak - warmth as punctuation, never on action.
transitions.why: POLISH-LAYER ONLY. Warm flare overlay across the boundary. max 1 - two leaks is an Instagram filter, not a film. NO SFX pairing on purpose: a leak with a whoosh is decoration.

transitions.when_scene: acceleration INTO an event - launch, overtake, drop. The outgoing shot's last ~300ms speeds up so the cut lands like a hit. Car pillars mostly.
transitions.why: NEEDS ENGINE POC (setpts ramp on the tail, frame-exact accounting) before any plan may declare it. timing=consume: the ramp eats real duration - TARGET_S must include it.

transitions.when_scene: a REVEAL lands - badge, price card, destination sign. Crash-zoom the last frames into the cut. HOUSE CAP APPLIES: punch <=1.4x (the 1.9x sharpness lesson).
transitions.why: NEEDS ENGINE POC. zoompan on the tail frames, capped 1.4x - 1.9x measured an 82% sharpness loss, the cap is not taste.

transitions.when_scene: phonk/drift energy - RGB split + frame stutter on the beat. car_cinematic ONLY; on a travel vlog it reads as an error.
transitions.why: POLISH LAYER, blocked until the Remotion PoC passes. Overlay-only = zero drift by construction.

transitions.when_scene: something in the FRAME crosses the lens - a passing truck, a pillar, the car itself - and the world is different behind it. The most cinematic wipe there is.
transitions.why: TWO executors: the PLAN must stage the crossing object (generation-side - prompt the foreground pass, planqc 24 linkage intent) and the polish layer masks the swap. Blocked until both exist. This is the transition that must be PLANNED, never found.

transitions.when_scene: a HIT on the beat - door slam, gear engage, bass drop. Camera-shake burst on the incoming shot's first frames.
transitions.why: POLISH LAYER, blocked until Remotion PoC. Pairs with sfx/impact low band - the shake IS the visual of the hit.

_still_open: duration_ms values are conventions carried from the desafarm plan, not derived from anything that measurably held attention.
requires_motion_out/in reuse the pillar's motion_floor scale but were never fitted for transitions specifically.
max_per_film numbers are taste, written down so they can be argued with. They are not measurements and must not be defended as such.
_session11_note: 2026-08-12: when_scene + executed_by added, wipe/light_leak added (polish layer, docs/REMOTION-MOGRAPH-SPEC.md). His catch: 'mostly whoosh' - the plan now picks per-boundary kinds by scene (planqc 37) and each kind brings ITS OWN sound from pairs_with_sfx, not the whip's.
_status_field: status: 'live' = an executor exists and is proven; 'needs_poc' = planqc 37 BLOCKS any plan declaring it until the executor lands (engine patch or Remotion PoC). An option without an executor is fiction - L140's inverse.
